title: G1 physical door & route calibration - Hall<->Corridor and Corridor<->Bedroom
coordinateNotes: Source-image pixels, origin upper-left, +x right, +y down (per first_floor_manifest.v1.json sourcePixel). NOT world-plan. NOT greybox. No implicit mapping between spaces.

baseEvidence.note: 09B is an AI-proposed architectural draft, not approved production geometry. This record calibrates only the HC and CB contacts on top of it.

actorFootprint.note: Ground-plane disk proxy only. Body/foreground depth is not proven by the flat painting.

projection.note: The approved PNG is already painted with its 65-degree elevation look. Actor feet are placed directly at image-pixel positions; the scene must not double-project the painted surface (see manifest worldPlanToPrototypeScreen).

doors.label: HC - Hall <-> Corridor
doors.normalMeaning: door plane horizontal at y=400; crossing north from Hall floor into the upper corridor
doors.clearanceSampleNote: minimum distance from either foot to the nearest 09B NO-GO polygon edge; 12px foot radius satisfied with margin
artChanges: Cut a 48px passage through the central stair landing / landing apron between the twin stair flights.
Reveal new floor + wall backfill under the landing (currently painted as landing/riser, not a walkable corridor).
Resolve landing elevation: the landing is above the Hall floor and the corridor sits behind it; the QA record assumes a flat ground-plane only.
Author foreground mask for the balustrade / landing edge so the actor is correctly occluded when passing under it.
doors.uncertainty: Landing elevation and the exact underside clearance cannot be derived from the flat painting; owner/art decision required.

doors.label: CB - Corridor <-> Bedroom
doors.normalMeaning: door plane vertical at x=528; crossing west from the corridor into the bedroom
doors.clearanceSampleNote: minimum distance from either foot to the nearest 09B NO-GO polygon edge; 12px foot radius satisfied with margin
artChanges: Cut a 48px opening in the bedroom partition wall at x=528 (y 352..400).
Reveal a bedroom-side floor sill where the corridor meets the bedroom south wall.
Add new jamb/trim foreground for the opening.
Keep the RM-DOOR-CORRIDOR-BEDROOM gate independent of bathroom repair (RM-DEC-006).
doors.uncertainty: The painted partition shows trim/wall caps, not an exposed threshold; the exact jamb position needs an art pass.

preservation.doorIds: RM-DOOR-HALL-CORRIDOR and RM-DOOR-CORRIDOR-BEDROOM preserved; lock state (open/gated) unchanged.
preservation.orthogonalRoutes: Existing 08B/09B authored room-owned orthogonal routes are not removed or renumbered.
preservation.approvedPng: Immutable; this record and its evidence never modify the PNG.

ownerApprovalRequired: Whether the HC under-landing passage is acceptable architecture (vs. an alternative Hall<->Corridor route).
Whether the CB partition opening is the correct bedroom threshold position.
Final opening widths, jamb/trim, floor backfill and foreground masks.
Elevation handling for the stair landing versus the flat QA ground-plane.
